names.note: Read out of saint.gr's line for 2 Μαρτίου, «Αγία Ευθαλία η παρθενομάρτυς», with the rank word left off.

Read out of the Ohrid Prologue's fifth heading for the Julian 2 March on pravoslavno.rs, „Света мученица Евталија.“, with the rank word мученица left off and Света, which is not a rank. The heading gives no epithet; Sicily, which the entry's first sentence names, is not in it.

Read out of the title on the name link behind the line for 2 марта ст. ст., name page 2477, «Евфалия Леентинская (Сицилийская), мц.», with the rank and office words left off. Both toponymics are part of the name the calendar’s index carries and both stay, the second in the brackets the source itself puts it in; the day’s own line gives the forename alone and in the genitive. `.tmp/foldchk.py` reports no folder holding this form and none holding the bare «Евфалия».

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 2 марта ст. ст. — «Мц. Евфалии (257).»

attestations.note: The Romanian calendar keeps her on 27 August and this one on the Julian 2 March, which is also the day the Greek and the Serbian give her; the difference between the two menologion numbers is neither a conversion nor a disagreement about her but two calendars keeping her on two days, and each row records its own.

feast.note: saint.gr's own life page for her closes «Σε κάποιον κώδικα Νο 73 της Μονής Παναγίας στη Χάλκη, η μνήμη της Αγίας φέρεται κατά την 27η Αυγούστου» — a codex numbered 73 of the monastery of the Panagia on Halki carries her memory on 27 August (https://www.saint.gr/3883/saint.aspx, read 30 September 2026). 27 august is the day doxologia.ro keeps her on and the day this folder's Romanian row already holds. The corpus keeps one feast to a church, so her Greek row is the day page that was read, the second of March.

source.text: saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 2ης Μαρτίου — «Αγία Ευθαλία η παρθενομάρτυς»

attestations.note: The page tells the same life this folder already carries from doxologia, in the same order and with the same names — the mother Euthalia with the flow of blood, the dream of Alphaeus, Philadelphus and Cyprinus whose memory it puts on 10 May, the brother Sermilianus, the servant struck blind, the beheading. It gives no year, no relic and no hymn, and it prints the distich «Υἱὸν φιλοῦσα Μητροπαρθένου Κόρης, / Τομὴν ὑπέστη καλλιπάρθενος Κόρη». The one thing it adds is the reading of the Halki codex, which is what identifies this entry with the 27 august one.

source.text: Православни подсетник (pravoslavno.rs), Охридски пролог за 15.03.2026 (2. март ст. ст.) — „Света мученица Евталија.“

attestations.note: The day's fifth and last entry. It tells the same life as the Romanian and Greek pages already quoted here, in the same order and with the same names, and gives no year, so the folder's empty `dates` is unchanged.

death.note: days.pravoslavie.ru closes her line for 2 марта ст. ст. with «(257)»: «Мц. Евфалии (257).» It is the only year any of the four sources read for her gives, and the folder carried no dates at all before this reading — doxologia.ro, saint.gr and the Охридски пролог print none. The life behind the line gives no year itself and names no emperor, so the year is the calendar’s bare statement and is marked traditional.
